paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
notes: BASE cryogenic Penning trap haloscope using antiproton detection circuit. Constrains g_agamma < 1e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP masses 2.7906-2.7914 neV. Local DM density rho_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. 95% power-constrained limit. Only the quoted upper limit value is available in text; data points approximate the narrow band exclusion.
